cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(superbuild_crossboundary_cmake_script_recipe C)

# The intersection of two nested-recipe shapes: a `cmake -P` recipe producer
# (the recipe is generated by a cmake script, not a plain tool) AND
# cross-boundary output placement (the generated SOURCE is written UP into the
# OUTER build tree, OUTER_GEN, while the recipe `.cmake` lands in the nested
# build dir).
#
# Both axes hit the same code: the recovery resolves the escaping gen source
# against the OUTER build dir that owns it (genSrcRelToOwningBuild), and the
# cmake-script BAKE must read the declared output from THAT owning dir — not the
# nested build dir it ran in. Converted with --cmake-script-bake (gate), the gen
# source must become a registered producer with its real bytes, not a frozen
# EMPTY file or a consumer-side bake.
set(SUBSRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/codegen)
set(SUBBUILD ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/codegen-build)
set(OUTER_GEN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)

execute_process(
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -S ${SUBSRC} -B ${SUBBUILD} -G Ninja -DOUTER_GEN_DIR=${OUTER_GEN}
  RESULT_VARIABLE _cfg
  OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET)
execute_process(
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build ${SUBBUILD}
  RESULT_VARIABLE _bld
  OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET)

add_executable(app main.c)

include(${SUBBUILD}/recipe/types.cmake)
